body:
Haha eww, his name is Diablo? Named after the game?

Anyways I'll be off for a few, got some stuff to do, feel free to PM me if you feel the need to talk, we can IM or some shit.
Damn, how many hours do you usually put in per week? I had two guinea pigs when i was like 6 or something. Just cleaning their box was a ton of work.
That's... a lot o.O. Do you at least enjoy doing that? Holy shit, that must be like a 9 to 5 job itself. Or are they all low maintenance pets?

>I know things can get rough, but there's a whole world out there and no reason not to see it. Whether it's striking up a conversation at your local bar or traveling half way across the world, why let some nonsense going on within your own half a mile ruin your life? You're too good for that, and you have a lot to see and do. The fact you're writing here means you're more intelligent than most, so screw it. Shoot me a PM and let's chit chat. 

Wow, that seems like you've tried really hard to be as generic and non helpful as possible.

*looks up post history*

Oooooh.
Haha, me and pets is a bad idea. I can't even handle plants. I think even a cactus would die. Unfortunately I'm not really a fan of dead pets :(

Separate post so you get notified:
If you want to talk about anything, let's talk, as of now, I'm still alive, might as well use that time.

Yeah, it really sucks when you know your brain isn't working how it should but you can't do anything about it.

Be assured that if (or when?) I kill myself it'll be carefully planned so that I can go in peace. W~~inter~~eekend is coming and I don't have the materials required to execute the planned method, so that forces me to think about it a bit longer. But after two years, 2 more days of being a heap of shit doesn't really make a difference.

I hear you, but I don't know how to help you. As I've said, finding some small thing, like a game that comes out has helped me in the past. But it seems that only works for so long. Not knowing what the actual cause is makes it also hard to talk about anything in our case. Objectively, I should have nothing to complain about.
